# Michael Tommaso

> Cornell University, B.S. Operations Research & Engineering, expected May 2029 (GPA 3.82).
> CTO and only engineer at McCallos, a three-person NYC property-compliance startup.
> Seeking Summer 2027 internships.

## Work

- [McCallos](https://mccallos.com): Chief Technology Officer, May 2026 to present. React/TypeScript web app and Capacitor iOS/Android apps on Firebase for NYC property managers. Pulls 17 city open-data feeds into one compliance calendar of 36 obligations; work orders assign each obligation or repair to a vendor with photo approval and a log of each step. Pilot planned. Code is private.
- AI Document Agent, Empire Environmental (AI Engineer, summer 2026): a Hermes agent that drafts DDC Site Safety Plans from a contract's bid set, with three-tier retrieval memory and a scoring harness against the firm's approved filings. Drafts score 98/100 across 25 templates (none below 83) at 2.4 minutes each; a vision pipeline cut one query from 413 seconds to 14. Installing at the firm in fall 2026.

## Projects

- [Coursemap](https://degree-planner-app.web.app): Cornell degree planner (work in progress, finishing before spring course selection in late November 2026). Gathers professor ratings, prerequisites and co-requisites, and typical offering terms; draws prerequisite chains on a semester map, marks courses green or red by whether their requirements are met, flags wrong-term placements, and ranks 15 Cornell majors by coverage using bipartite matching.
- [Guitar Tutor](https://github.com/michaeljtommaso/guitar-training-software): browser app (work in progress) that watches the fretting hand by webcam, places chord targets on the real fretboard, identifies played chords from the mic, and includes an amp-tone chain.
- Mimir + Bifrost: a personal Hermes agent on Michael's server, reached over Telegram, with helper agents for research, errands, and calendar; Bifrost is the FastAPI + React command center where he queues work and approves anything that spends money or publishes. Private.

## Client work

- [Il Colosseo Ristorante](https://ilcolosseoristorante.com): new site for a two-location restaurant; organic clicks +140%, impressions +134% to 25.3K after merging a split domain and redirecting 27 legacy URLs; catering inquiries via Firebase Cloud Functions.
- [Closet Curations Co.](https://closetcurationco.com): styling-studio site with Calendly booking and an animated portfolio.
